summary: Round 2 found one live, open grant call on the funder site: Cities Deliver (RF + OpenAI Foundation, USD 50M, call live since 2026-10-14, first-round deadline 2026-11-29 11:59pm ET, round 2 due 2027-03-01). It is exposed as WordPress REST page record id 94440 (slug cities-deliver-ai-solutions-for-public-services), which json_api reads with plain HTTP. Limits: the record has no deadline field (deadline lives only in body text, so deadline is null) and json_api hardcodes status open, so the row will stay open after the deadline passes unless removed. Application itself is on citiesdeliver.rockefellerfoundation.org (SimplyRQ, login-gated, not usable). No other open grant call found on the funder site.

engine_requirements: Use json_api as configured in adapter_config. Known gaps the parent should decide on before enabling: (1) deadline is not a field in the WP record, so json_api leaves it null; a deadline would need the body text ("November 29, 2026" after "Eligibility Screening, Round 1") parsed by a new rule. (2) json_api sets status open for every item, so this row stays open after 2026-11-29 unless the row is expired by hand or the function drops rows whose stored deadline is past. Alternative: the html adapter on the call page gives change detection plus next_deadline from labeled future dates, with no opportunity row.
